subject: Renewal entitlement realignment & procurement portal steps
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <procurement@helionhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal entitlement realignment & procurement portal steps

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

We are starting renewal planning for our Redwood agreement (current term ends 2026-06-30). A few asks so we can align procurement and legal:

- Helion would like to move from a 12-month to a 24-month term starting on renewal, and enroll in the seat uplift (+20% capacity) for anticipated usage growth.
- Procurement portal: please confirm the steps so our Sourcing team can submit the PO and vendor onboarding refresh.
- Evidence: we need a SOC 2 attestation copy and any recent security questionnaire summary to attach to our vendor file.
- Billing/legal: we need the exact legal entity name to show on the PO and your preferred invoice remit details.

I've attached a short workbook with our internal renewal request fields (Attachment: Helion_Renewal_Req.xlsx).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will allow a single consolidated PO for the uplift (preferred), or whether we should split into a base+top-up PO? Also, bumping to a 24m term means we may need a pricing cadence note to close procurement ahead of our June board review.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Sourcing Manager, Helion Health
procurement@helionhealth.com

Attachment: Helion_Renewal_Req.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <procurement@helionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal entitlement realignment & procurement portal steps

Jordan — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to run point on the procurement flow. Proposed next steps (high level):

1) We confirm commercial terms (24m term, +20% seats) and produce a one‑page quote you can attach to the PO.
2) You submit vendor update + PO draft via our vendor portal (link below). That kicks off vendor onboarding refresh and evidence collection.
3) Legal & Finance review the quote/PO. We can prefill PO fields for Helion to reduce back‑and‑forth.
4) Once PO is approved, we schedule effective date and seat provisioning.

A few asks to unblock us:
- Please confirm the legal entity exactly as it should appear on the PO and the remit address + tax ID.
- If you prefer a single consolidated PO for the uplift, note that in the portal comments. Otherwise select the split PO option.
- If you can attach the most recent SOC 2 snapshot (or an attestation date), that speeds lender/secure procurement approvals.

Portal link: https://redwood.procureflow.com/vendor-onboard/HELION-3479
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/RDW-2026-3479

I attached our vendor onboarding checklist to show required fields (Attachment: vendor_onboard_checklist.csv).

Proposed timeline: 3 business days to provide legal name and SOC2 snapshot -> portal submission same week -> Finance/Legal review ~5–7 business days. If you need an expedited lane for June close, call that out and we'll route as an exception.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboard_checklist.csv (csv)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 13:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal entitlement realignment & procurement portal steps

Aditya — quick internal note on approvals and what to expect from our side: 

- Finance review: Ben, please prepare an estimated prepaid vs monthly billing impact for a 24m term and the +20% uplift (we should show both consolidated PO and split PO scenarios).
- Legal review: Kimberly, please confirm whether a 24m term needs a contract amendment or a new PO + SOW. Also flag any standard SLA exceptions tied to capacity increases.
- Evidence: legal will accept a SOC 2 snapshot (report summary) in lieu of full audit docs; procurement can waive a full re‑accreditation if Helion's attestation is dated within the last 12 months.

Aditya, when you get Helion's legal name/tax ID, please also capture: account owner billing contact and which Redwood legal entity they should route the invoice to (we have a few).

Suggested internal timeline:
- Tue/Wed: Helion to submit vendor portal update and attach SOC2 snapshot.
- End of week: Redwood Legal & Finance review & return comments.
- Week of 2026-05-04: PO issuance and provisioning prep.

Attachment: approval_matrix.png (png)

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations — Redwood Inference

Jordan — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOC 2 date. Confirming next steps and owners so we can close before your June board review: 

Action items:
- Helion (Jordan): Submit the portal vendor update and attach SOC 2 snapshot + PO draft today. Indicate preference for a single consolidated PO for the +20% uplift. (Owner: Helion)
- Aditya (me): Prepare a one‑page quote reflecting 24m term +20% seats and include prefill PO fields; I will attach the quote to the portal record. (Owner: Aditya)
- Ben (Finance): Build quick comparison: consolidated PO vs split PO impact on prepaid recognition and monthly burn. Share by EOD Mon. (Owner: Ben)
- Kimberly (Legal): Confirm whether amendment vs new SOW required and flag any SLA/term language that must be surfaced to Helion. (Owner: Kimberly)

If everyone is aligned on the timeline above we will treat this as a high‑priority renewal and request expedited review from Legal/Finance. Jordan — please cc procurement@redwood.com into the portal submission so Ben sees the PO draft.

I'll follow up with the one‑page quote once Ben confirms the accounting impact.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
